item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 08, 2026
item.description: Surprises could rock the boat, but they shouldn't capsize it. With romantic Venus squaring unpredictable Uranus at 4:48 am EST, our connections and money choices hit friction as new needs clash with old comfort zones. Slow down! Rushing will probably cause more problems, especially if group commitments are involved. item.title: Norfolk State men halt skid, knock off MEAC contender NC Central behind Jamison’s bounce-back game
item.description: Elijah Jamison scored 28 points on 8-of-11 shooting Saturday night as Norfolk State bounced back from back-to-back losses. Six teams sit within two games of first place in the MEAC.

item.title: Photos: NSU wins heated game over NC Central
item.description: The Norfolk State Spartans beat the North Carolina Central Eagles 75-68 at Echols Hall in Norfolk, Virginia, on February 7, 2026.

item.title: En’Dya Buford guides ODU women to MAC-SBC Challenge victory at Ohio
item.description: Buford had 26 points, eight rebounds, two blocks and three steals.

item.title: Seth Trimble’s 3-pointer caps No. 14 UNC’s double court-storm after rally past No. 4 Duke
item.description: The rivalry's latest twist was fans storming the court prematurely before having to clear out for the Blue Devils to get one desperate final play. UNC's only lead all night was the final score.

item.title: Cox wrestling team grapples to Class 5 Region A trophy
item.description: With six region champions, the Falcons hope that's a good omen as they aim to repeat their state team championship.

item.title: After ‘wakeup call,’ ODU men hold off Ohio
item.description: It turns out an alarm clock — both figuratively and literally — was just what the Monarchs needed to gain their first home victory of 2026.

item.title: No offense: Admirals drop series with shutout loss to Allen in Texas
item.description: Goalie Marco Costantini, who was named the night's No. 1 star, earned a shutout with 31 saves, giving the Americans two victories in the three-game set.

item.title: High school scoreboard: First Colonial, Norfolk Academy swim to championships
item.description: Meanwhile, Cape Henry Collegiate wins TCIS trophies in wrestling and competition cheer, and eighth-ranked boys basketball team Nansemond River upends No. 6 Denbigh.
